safety_verdicts.content: Diarrhoea is associated with abdominal pain.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states diarrhoea associated with abdominal pain; generated facts do not mention abdominal pain.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting associated abdominal pain reduces clinical context for acute diarrhoea and can obscure a potentially important red-flag feature that may change differential diagnosis (e.g., inflammatory/infectious colitis, surgical abdomen) and escalation/assessment decisions. This is more than administrative noise but typically results in additional questioning/monitoring rather than direct immediate harm in most cases.
